finding.title: Session id is no longer rotated at sign-in
finding.explanation: The PR deletes the `regenerateSession(req)` call that ran before the user id was written. Without it, the session id a visitor had before signing in stays valid afterwards. Anyone who planted that id, on a shared computer or through a cookie set on a sibling subdomain, is now signed in as the victim.
finding.reasoningSummary: The deleted line was the only call to regenerateSession. express-session keeps the existing id unless regenerate() is called. The PR description does not mention removing it, so it looks accidental.
